processing.rule: Fetch and hash the official catalog tileset, recursively resolve and hash every referenced source tileset, then fetch, validate as b3dm, and hash every unique LOD1/LOD2 content URI.
processing.acquisition_mode: Every 3D tile byte was fetched and hashed. The repository stores the deterministic URL/hash manifest rather than duplicating the public tile cache.
